column1: # VALID documents only, and deliberately so. An `err:<marker>` example would
# hand over an input-to-marker mapping, and those inputs are exactly the
# evaluation set — the draft would be scored partly on answers it was given.
# Mapping a spec rule onto a marker name unaided is the experiment.
# These still do real work: they stop a degenerate draft that rejects
# everything from passing the marker and liveness gates.
# Every line is an example from the TOML 1.1.0 Integer section itself.
